## Our solutions

Our portfolio of informatics solutions—medical device integration, system integration engine, cloud

seamlessly integrate with each other and your existing hospital systems.

[card-medical-device-integration]

## Medical Device Integration

Unlock the value of your medical devices with a vendor neutral platform that enables secure capture
of virtually all live-streaming data – measurements, settings, alarms and waveforms – from over
1,200 different medical devices. Data can be delivered using industry standard protocols to over 100
different systems, including electronic health records (EHRs), clinical information systems,
decision support, alarm management, research and reporting.

### Explore our connectivity management solutions:
* [Philips Axon][88]
* [Capsule Neuron][89]
* [Capsule Vitals Stream][90]
* [Chart Xpress][91]

### Explore our data management solution:
* [Medical Device Information Platform][92]
* [Advanced Integration][93]

[ Request a demo ][94]
[card-virtual-care]

## Virtual Care

As health systems turn to virtual care models to address staffing shortages, eCareManager helps by
enabling inpatient care teams to seamlessly connect with remote clinicians. Timely insights,
customizable alerts and data-driven benchmarks with a goal of helping ensure the quality and
efficiency of patient care delivery.

### Explore our solutions:

[eCareManager][95]

[ Request a demo ][96]
[card-retrospective-analytics]

## Retrospective Analytics

Clinical Insights Manager is a service-oriented, end-to-end solution that allows hospitals to
synthesize high-fidelity clinical data. It combines storage and aggregation of data with tools that
allow you to query, filter and sort it so you can transform this information into valuable insights
that help you achieve your clinical healthcare goals.

### Explore our solution:

[Clinical Insights Manager][97]

[ Request a demo ][98]
[card-surveillance]

## Surveillance

Capsule Surveillance helps simplify complex workflows and makes patient monitoring insightful by
continuous analysis of live, streaming medical data. Clinical surveillance facilitates proactive
care by sending precise notifications to the healthcare team.

### Explore our solutions:

[Capsule Surveillance][99]

[ Request a demo ][100]
[card-clinical-information-system]

## Clinical Information System

Philips IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA) is a clinical decision support and
documentation solution for the complex critical and perioperative care environments. ICCA
centralizes, streamlines and provides simplified visual data to deliver structured documentation and
support high-quality and efficient care delivery.

### Explore our solution:

[IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anethesia][101]

[ Request a demo ][102]

multiple solutions to reduce vendor complexity.

clinical staff, not burden them.

Our vendor-neutral approach allows healthcare organizations to utilize their current infrastructure
and progressively expand, ensuring a tailored approach for every stage of the transformation
journey.

## Our solutions

Our portfolio of informatics solutions—medical device integration, system integration engine, cloud
data storage and analytics, clinical surveillance, intensive care and perioperative patient data
management, and virtual care—provides not just individual products, but a suite of applications that
seamlessly integrate with each other and your existing hospital systems.

## Medical Device Integration

Unlock the value of your medical devices with a vendor neutral platform that enables secure capture
of virtually all live-streaming data – measurements, settings, alarms and waveforms – from over
1,200 different medical devices. Data can be delivered using industry standard protocols to over 100
different systems, including electronic health records (EHRs), clinical information systems,
decision support, alarm management, research and reporting.

enabling inpatient care teams to seamlessly connect with remote clinicians. Timely insights,
customizable alerts and data-driven benchmarks with a goal of helping ensure the quality and
efficiency of patient care delivery.

synthesize high-fidelity clinical data. It combines storage and aggregation of data with tools that
allow you to query, filter and sort it so you can transform this information into valuable insights
that help you achieve your clinical healthcare goals.

continuous analysis of live, streaming medical data. Clinical surveillance facilitates proactive
care by sending precise notifications to the healthcare team.

## Find your way to wellness

Nature’s Way offers a diverse range of products designed to support your unique wellness journey.
Whether you're looking for immune support, specially formulated multivitamins, or a probiotic,
there's something for everyone.*

Explore and find the perfect additions to incorporate into your daily wellness routine today.

[ SHOP NOW ][188]
* Elderberry
  
  ### Better berries
  
  For centuries, elderberries have been traditionally used for immune support.* Sambucus elderberry
  products are made with our 64x concentrated black elderberry extract.
  
  [ Explore Elderberries ][189]
* Herbs
  
  ### Wellness rooted in nature
  
  Discover herbs traditionally used to support digestive health, immune function, sleep, and much
  more!* Since 1969, we’ve crafted our herbal supplements to honor tradition while embracing
  innovation.
  
  [ explore herbs ][190]
* Multivitamins
  
  ### Your multi, your way
  
  We offer multivitamins tailored to your unique needs. From kids and adults to 50+ formulas and
  varying potencies, find your perfect fit and add a new favorite to your daily wellness routine.
  
  [ Find my multi ][191]
* Kid's Health*
  
  ### Support growing minds and bodies*
  
  Whether they’re learning new things in the classroom or playing with friends on the jungle gym,
  make sure your kids are getting the support they need to thrive as they grow up.
  
  [ Kid's essentials ][192]

OUR HERBS

## Herbs are foundational to Nature's Way

Our journey with herbs began in 1969, and they've remained the cornerstone of our brand. Our herbal
supplements are rooted in tradition, guided by innovation, and held to the highest quality
standards.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Turn-Key bottling solutions to match your brands specifications. We handle the entire production
chain so you can focus on selling.

✅

### Quality & Compliance

FDA-registered, cGMP-certified facility with rigorous in-house testing. Every batch documented, all
materials traceable.

Our Edge

## LIPOSOMAL TECHNOLOGY

The manufacturing capability most competitors can't offer — at minimums they wouldn't consider. When
your products use liposomal delivery and your competitor's don't, the clinical story sells itself.

→

#### Superior Bioavailability and Absorption

Liposomes protect active ingredients from degradation in the stomach acid and enzymes, allowing much
higher absorption rates (often 3–5x or more compared to standard forms) so more of the nutrient or
drug actually reaches your bloodstream and cells.

→

#### Enhanced Protection and Stability

The phospholipid bilayer shields sensitive compounds (like vitamin C, curcumin, or glutathione) from
the harsh gastrointestinal environment, improving stability, extending shelf life, and enabling
better intracellular delivery.

→

#### Mimics Body's Own Cells for Better Uptake

Made from phospholipids similar to cell membranes, liposomes fuse easily with cells, facilitating
direct and efficient transport of both water-soluble and fat-soluble substances while often
requiring lower doses for the same effect.

→

#### Gentler and More Effective Delivery

It's non-invasive, reduces gastrointestinal irritation or side effects from high doses, supports
targeted or sustained release, and provides a more tolerable option than injections or poorly
absorbed traditional supplements.

Most contract manufacturers ignore brands ordering under 250K units. We built our entire operation

### The Problem

Emerging supplement brands can't get the time of day from major manufacturers. High MOQs, long lead
times, and zero flexibility keep growing brands stuck.

### Who We Work With

Founders and brand owners at $10K–$10M supplement companies. You know your product and your market —
you need a manufacturing partner who won't treat you like a small account.

### Our Promise

**Your formula gets the same attention whether you order 50K or a million+ softgels.** When you work
with us you get a personable trustworthy American Made manufacturer with low MOQ's and Quick
Turnarounds.

What We Do

End-to-end softgel manufacturing from formula development through finished goods. Every step under
one roof.

Precision-engineered softgel capsules across a wide range of fill weights, shapes, and shell
compositions. Standard and specialty formats.

🔬

### Liposomal Technology

Advanced liposomal delivery systems that improve bioavailability. Very few facilities can do this at
any scale — we do it at accessible minimums.

🧪

### Custom Formulation

⚗️

🏷️

### Turn-Key Labeling

Full label design, printing, and application. Go from formula to shelf-ready product without
managing multiple vendors.

📦

### Packaging & Fulfillment

Turn-Key bottling solutions to match your brands specifications. We handle the entire production
chain so you can focus on selling.

✅

### Quality & Compliance

FDA-registered, cGMP-certified facility with rigorous in-house testing. Every batch documented, all
materials traceable.

Our Edge

## LIPOSOMAL TECHNOLOGY

The manufacturing capability most competitors can't offer — at minimums they wouldn't consider. When
your products use liposomal delivery and your competitor's don't, the clinical story sells itself.

→

#### Superior Bioavailability and Absorption

Liposomes protect active ingredients from degradation in the stomach acid and enzymes, allowing much
higher absorption rates (often 3–5x or more compared to standard forms) so more of the nutrient or
drug actually reaches your bloodstream and cells.

→

#### Enhanced Protection and Stability

The phospholipid bilayer shields sensitive compounds (like vitamin C, curcumin, or glutathione) from
the harsh gastrointestinal environment, improving stability, extending shelf life, and enabling
better intracellular delivery.

→

#### Mimics Body's Own Cells for Better Uptake

Made from phospholipids similar to cell membranes, liposomes fuse easily with cells, facilitating
direct and efficient transport of both water-soluble and fat-soluble substances while often
requiring lower doses for the same effect.

→

#### Gentler and More Effective Delivery

It's non-invasive, reduces gastrointestinal irritation or side effects from high doses, supports
targeted or sustained release, and provides a more tolerable option than injections or poorly
absorbed traditional supplements.

This certification program provides a way for companies to test their products to the highest
quality, safety, and purity standards in the world.

This program allows companies to showcase their high quality products, and provide consumers with an
easy way to compare krill oil products before they buy.

This program has been developed to address the growing global interest in algal oil products

### IGEN™

This program certifies ingredients and products as "Non-GMO Tested," verifying that the finished
product does not contain detectable modified genetic material.

This program helps companies be more transparent in how their probiotics are manufactured, handled,
tested, stored, shipped, and labeled

[ [IPRO] ][51]
[ [Nutrastrong] ][52]

### Nutrastrong™

A program designed to gatekeep against companies with misleading claims, inaccurate or false
Certificate of Analyses (COAs)

### RTCP™

A per lot testing program that analyzes products in order to detect the presence of the principal
radionuclides associated with accidents involving nuclear reactors.

## We Do
## Custom Manufacturing

Fermentis Life Sciences has extensive experience producing nutraceuticals and health supplements in
a number of dose formats. Depending on the type of dosage form, we employ different procedures to
prepare it.

[ read more ][124]

## Tablet Manufacturing

Tablets are basically compressed powder that can be formed into any desired shape of choice. When
compared to capsules, a tablet has the advantage of being able to pack more powder into a smaller
pill. These are the tablets we make –

Direct compressed tablets

Wet granulation process

Dry granulation process

Coated tablets

## Capsule Manufacturing

Capsules are easy to dissolve and can hold pellets and powdered blends very nicely. They are ideal
for micronutrient requirements. The shell can be produced from a variety of materials, including
gelatin or a vegetarian-friendly formulation. We manufacture these types of capsules –

Capsules with natural extracts

Wet & dry granulated capsules

Vegetarian capsules

Capsule filling

## Powdered blends

These can be consumed in milk or water. There are various products that can be made into powdered
blends like protein powders, shakes, and health drinks to name a few. The process is as follows-

(1) Raw material collection

(2) Blending them into a homogenous mixture

(3) Filling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Labelling and sealing

## Gummies

These are the latest trends in the nutraceutical industry. It is easy and yummy. Following is the
process –

(1) Ingredient mixing homogeneously

(2) Transferring to desirable shape

(3) Cooling

(4) Unmolding

(5) Packing into bottles

## Liquids

These are perfect for on-the-go shots for products like proteins, amino acids or even energy water.
The process for liquids is –

(1) Blending of all the ingredients into a homogenous mixture

(2) Heating or cooling according to the product requirement

(3) Bottling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Testing and bulk packaging

## Softgel Manufacturing

Softgels can be adjusted in terms of shape, colour, and size to fit your needs. Softgels encapsulate
liquids rather than powder, resulting in greater absorbability.

(1) Gelatin Filling & Encapsulation

(2) Fill Material Preparation

(3) Drying Tunnel Cleaning

(4) Final Inspection

(5) Tumble Drying

## Custom Manufacturing

Fermentis Life Sciences has extensive experience producing nutraceuticals and health supplements in
a number of dose formats. Depending on the type of dosage form, we employ different procedures to
prepare it.

[ read more ][124]

## Tablet Manufacturing

Tablets are basically compressed powder that can be formed into any desired shape of choice. When
compared to capsules, a tablet has the advantage of being able to pack more powder into a smaller
pill. These are the tablets we make –

Direct compressed tablets

Wet granulation process

Dry granulation process

Coated tablets

## Capsule Manufacturing

Capsules are easy to dissolve and can hold pellets and powdered blends very nicely. They are ideal
for micronutrient requirements. The shell can be produced from a variety of materials, including
gelatin or a vegetarian-friendly formulation. We manufacture these types of capsules –

Capsules with natural extracts

Wet & dry granulated capsules

Vegetarian capsules

Capsule filling

## Powdered blends

These can be consumed in milk or water. There are various products that can be made into powdered
blends like protein powders, shakes, and health drinks to name a few. The process is as follows-

(1) Raw material collection

(2) Blending them into a homogenous mixture

(3) Filling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Labelling and sealing

## Gummies

These are the latest trends in the nutraceutical industry. It is easy and yummy. Following is the
process –

(1) Ingredient mixing homogeneously

(2) Transferring to desirable shape

(3) Cooling

(4) Unmolding

(5) Packing into bottles

## Liquids

These are perfect for on-the-go shots for products like proteins, amino acids or even energy water.
The process for liquids is –

(1) Blending of all the ingredients into a homogenous mixture

(2) Heating or cooling according to the product requirement

(3) Bottling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Testing and bulk packaging

## Softgel Manufacturing

Softgels can be adjusted in terms of shape, colour, and size to fit your needs. Softgels encapsulate
liquids rather than powder, resulting in greater absorbability.

(1) Gelatin Filling & Encapsulation

(2) Fill Material Preparation

(3) Drying Tunnel Cleaning

(4) Final Inspection

(5) Tumble Drying

How to Select the Right Gelatin for Softgel Manufacturing
2026-07-20
How to Select the Right Gelatin for Softgel Manufacturing Selecting the right gelatin is one of the
most critical decisions in softgel manufacturing. The quality and characteristics of gelatin
directly determine capsule integrity, stability, production efficiency, and ultimately, the
bioavailability of the active ingredients. A poorly chosen gelatin can lead to leakage, brittleness,
poor sealing, inconsistent dissolution, and costly production delays. This guide outlines the key
factors to consider when sourcing gelatin for your softgel production. 1. Understand Gelatin Types:
Type A vs. Type B Gelatin is classified into two main types based on the manufacturing process, each
with distinct properties: Type A Gelatin – Produced through an acid pretreatment process, primarily
from porcine skin or connective tissue. It has a lower pH and generally lower viscosity compared to
Type B. Type A is commonly used in applications requiring clarity and faster setting. Type B
Gelatin – Produced through an alkaline (lime) pretreatment process, mainly from bovine hides or
bones. It has a higher pH, higher viscosity, and produces stronger gels with less leakage. The
processing time is significantly longer—up to several weeks. Property Type A Type B Raw Material

## Veelgestelde vragen

Waar kan ik lege capsules kopen en van welke kwaliteit zijn ze?

Bij Lege-Capsules.com bestelt u lege capsules van farmaceutische kwaliteit: onze gelatinecapsules
zijn BSE-compliant, geproduceerd conform de internationale WOAH-norm en de Europese GMP-richtlijnen,
met een traceerbaar batchnummer op elk etiket. Wij bieden het meest complete assortiment in
Nederland: gelatine, vegetarisch/HPMC en maagsapresistent, in alle gangbare maten, zonder
minimumbestelling.

Welke capsulemaat heb ik nodig?

De meest gebruikte maat is maat 0 (ca. 500–680 mg poeder). Voor meer of minder inhoud zijn er maten
van 000 t/m 5. Bekijk onze [**complete maatgids**][158] met capaciteitstabel.

Wat is het verschil tussen gelatine en vegetarische capsules?

[**Gelatinecapsules**][159] zijn gemaakt van farmaceutisch-grade rundergelatine (BSE-compliant,
alkaline verwerkt) en lossen snel op in de maag. [**Vegetarische HPMC-capsules**][160] zijn 100%
plantaardig, geschikt voor vegans en vegetariërs, en stabieler bij hogere luchtvochtigheid. Beide
typen zijn leverbaar in alle maten en geschikt voor droge en poedervormige vullingen.

Hoe vul ik lege capsules?

Capsules vult u met een mini-lepeltje of een [**capsuleermachine**][161]. Bekijk het uitgebreide
[**stappenplan**][162] voor het vullen met en zonder machine.

Zijn de gelatinecapsules BSE-veilig en van welke kwaliteit?

Ja, de gelatinecapsules voldoen aan de internationale BSE-veiligheidsnormen van de WOAH (Terrestrial
Animal Health Code) en de Europese farmaceutische en voedselregelgeving (EC 853/2004, EC 999/2001,
EMA/410/01). De rundergelatine wordt alkaline verwerkt op farmaceutisch niveau en is alleen
afkomstig van leveranciers met een Europees Certificate of Suitability (CEP) van de EDQM. Per
levering is een Certificate of Analysis op aanvraag beschikbaar met de BSE-veiligheidsverklaring.

## Veelgestelde vragen

Waar kan ik lege capsules kopen en van welke kwaliteit zijn ze?

Bij Lege-Capsules.com bestelt u lege capsules van farmaceutische kwaliteit: onze gelatinecapsules
zijn BSE-compliant, geproduceerd conform de internationale WOAH-norm en de Europese GMP-richtlijnen,
met een traceerbaar batchnummer op elk etiket. Wij bieden het meest complete assortiment in
Nederland: gelatine, vegetarisch/HPMC en maagsapresistent, in alle gangbare maten, zonder
minimumbestelling.

Welke capsulemaat heb ik nodig?

De meest gebruikte maat is maat 0 (ca. 500–680 mg poeder). Voor meer of minder inhoud zijn er maten
van 000 t/m 5. Bekijk onze [**complete maatgids**][158] met capaciteitstabel.

Wat is het verschil tussen gelatine en vegetarische capsules?

[**Gelatinecapsules**][159] zijn gemaakt van farmaceutisch-grade rundergelatine (BSE-compliant,
alkaline verwerkt) en lossen snel op in de maag. [**Vegetarische HPMC-capsules**][160] zijn 100%
plantaardig, geschikt voor vegans en vegetariërs, en stabieler bij hogere luchtvochtigheid. Beide
typen zijn leverbaar in alle maten en geschikt voor droge en poedervormige vullingen.

Hoe vul ik lege capsules?

Capsules vult u met een mini-lepeltje of een [**capsuleermachine**][161]. Bekijk het uitgebreide
[**stappenplan**][162] voor het vullen met en zonder machine.

Zijn de gelatinecapsules BSE-veilig en van welke kwaliteit?

Ja, de gelatinecapsules voldoen aan de internationale BSE-veiligheidsnormen van de WOAH (Terrestrial
Animal Health Code) en de Europese farmaceutische en voedselregelgeving (EC 853/2004, EC 999/2001,
EMA/410/01). De rundergelatine wordt alkaline verwerkt op farmaceutisch niveau en is alleen
afkomstig van leveranciers met een Europees Certificate of Suitability (CEP) van de EDQM. Per
levering is een Certificate of Analysis op aanvraag beschikbaar met de BSE-veiligheidsverklaring.

# LIFEVISION HEALTHCARE

## Boosting Healthcare- Revolutionized the Pharma Sector in India

**[Lifevision Healthcare][171]** has been performing as the prominent third party pharma
manufacturer with the glorious experience of 12 years and now heading towards the milestones to
achieve. With the great dedication and efforts, we have made a name of pride and growth and marked
our presence in the pharmaceutical sector of India. We have been appreciated by various reputed
brands due to our safe and effective high quality products and reliable prices. For every kind of
disease, we have a separate range of pharmaceutical products which are available at every nook and
corner of the nation to serve the humanity. Our every product comes with very best price. This is
our motive to make a revolution in healthcare industry and that is why the cost is very low and
effective so that every citizen of India can get help benefits.

As a third party pharma manufacturer, we are serving 10+ pharma segments to the human beings. The
offered pharma segments include neurology, cardiology, nphrology, gynecology, nutraceutical,
[pediatrics range][172], cosmetics, [dermatology][173], orthopedics, etc. Lifevision Healthcare
initiated its journey of serving people with high quality products in 2010. We have arrived with
various products such as Tablets, Syrups, Capsules, [Ointments][174], Sachets, Drops, powders,
ointments, [softgels][175], etc. Due to our remarkable qualities and outstanding approach, we have
earned a tag of best pharma contract manufacturer & supplier. Our every product is DCGI approved.
**Lifevision Healthcare is ISO certified pharma manufacturing company** which is reliable and more
authentic than others. **Associate with us if you want to manufacture pharmaceutical medicines on
third party manufacturing or contract manufacturing basis.**

Iso certified

Why Medikonda? Gain instant access to 2,000+ ingredients, downloadable QC documents, and

* ### Instant access to the industry’s most comprehensive catalog

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and

## How it works?

Why Medikonda? Gain instant access to 2,000+ ingredients, downloadable QC documents, and
ready-to-use starter formulations, US ready inventory—all in one place.
* ### Instant access to the industry’s most comprehensive catalog
  
  *Browse, search, and filter the USA’s largest food ingredient catalog with ease.*
* ### Order samples, access QC docs, and secure quotes instantly
  
  *The Medikonda Concierge manages all your requests and ensures they’re processed faster than
  ever.*
* ### Real-time inventory, right here in the USA
  
  *Tiered pricing, real-time U.S. inventory, expert food technologist support, and everything you
  need to accelerate product development.*

1 / of 3

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this
  option.

Glycative Stress Research

Original article

Evaluation in vitro of AGE-crosslinks breaking ability of rosmarinic acid

 

Daniel Jean 1), Maryse Pouligon 1), Claude Dalle 2)

 

1) Institut des Substances Végétales, Beaumont, France

2) World Society Interdisciplinary Anti-aging Medicine, Paris, France

Abstract

 

Objective: Although numerous works were carried out to evaluate the ability of various molecules to
break AGE, none of them, to our best knowledge, were done to evaluate the ability of these molecules
to break protein crosslinks considered globally. The objective of this work was to show clearly the
albumin polymerization elicited by reaction with ribose and the ability of a polyphenolic acid
extracted from rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis), rosmarinic acid, to break preformed albumin
polymers.

Methods: Albumin was glycated by incubation with ribose and the resulting albumin polymers were
evaluated by the size exclusion Chromatography (SEC) and fluorimetry. After elimination of ribose by
dialysis, the proteins were treated by rosmarinic acid, aminoguanidine, carnosine, and Alagebrium
(ALT-711; Alteon) as a positive control. Reversion of glycation was measured by the ratio between
polymerized and native albumin before and after treatment by the reversing molecules.

Results: Rosmarinic acid was shown to be an as good crosslinks-breaker as Alagebrium. At the
opposite, aminoguanidine and carnosine, the glycation reaction inhibitors do not produce a
significant reversion of albumin polymerization.

Discussion: Albumin polymerization elicited by glycation by ribose can be measured by SEC and
fluorimetry of the resulting polymers. We have shown that rosmarinic acid is able to reverse this
polymerization to a similar extent to Alagebrium.

Conclusion: Rosmarinic acid seems a promising molecule, known as safe and able in vitro to break
protein AGE-related crosslinks approximately as efficiently as Alagebrium, considered until now as
the reference molecule in this field. It could be a promising treatment of diabetics, skin aging,
and of elderly impaired vessels-related diseases as nephropathy, neuropathy and retinopathy.

Original article

Evaluation in vitro of AGE-crosslinks breaking ability of rosmarinic acid

 

Daniel Jean 1), Maryse Pouligon 1), Claude Dalle 2)

 

1) Institut des Substances Végétales, Beaumont, France

2) World Society Interdisciplinary Anti-aging Medicine, Paris, France

Abstract

 

Objective: Although numerous works were carried out to evaluate the ability of various molecules to
break AGE, none of them, to our best knowledge, were done to evaluate the ability of these molecules
to break protein crosslinks considered globally. The objective of this work was to show clearly the
albumin polymerization elicited by reaction with ribose and the ability of a polyphenolic acid
extracted from rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis), rosmarinic acid, to break preformed albumin
polymers.

Methods: Albumin was glycated by incubation with ribose and the resulting albumin polymers were
evaluated by the size exclusion Chromatography (SEC) and fluorimetry. After elimination of ribose by
dialysis, the proteins were treated by rosmarinic acid, aminoguanidine, carnosine, and Alagebrium
(ALT-711; Alteon) as a positive control. Reversion of glycation was measured by the ratio between
polymerized and native albumin before and after treatment by the reversing molecules.

Results: Rosmarinic acid was shown to be an as good crosslinks-breaker as Alagebrium. At the
opposite, aminoguanidine and carnosine, the glycation reaction inhibitors do not produce a
significant reversion of albumin polymerization.

Discussion: Albumin polymerization elicited by glycation by ribose can be measured by SEC and
fluorimetry of the resulting polymers. We have shown that rosmarinic acid is able to reverse this
polymerization to a similar extent to Alagebrium.

Conclusion: Rosmarinic acid seems a promising molecule, known as safe and able in vitro to break
protein AGE-related crosslinks approximately as efficiently as Alagebrium, considered until now as
the reference molecule in this field. It could be a promising treatment of diabetics, skin aging,
and of elderly impaired vessels-related diseases as nephropathy, neuropathy and retinopathy.

# Nutraceutical and Supplement:

**Private Labeling | Contract Packaging | Materials Sourcing**

**Supplement Manufacturer USA**
NutraPak USA provides quality private-label softgels, gelcaps, caplets, tablets and capsules in
plastic bottles, blister packs or pouches, and liquids in glass or plastic bottles, utilizing a wide
variety of caps, pumps, and seals. We provide a high level of customer care and extremely
competitive pricing for [**private label retailers**][83] and contract manufacturers all over the
United States. Nutraceutical supplements produced by NutraPak USA for our clients are sold in
Walmart, Walgreens, CVS and most other major retailers. We work closely with some of the leading
brands in the natural products industry, as well as pharmaceutical companies, to produce special
formulas and combinations for their respective markets.

NutraPak USA is strongly committed to providing customers with green, eco-friendly, sustainable
packaging. Our fully-green option gives clients a strong marketing advantage with
environmentally-conscious consumers.

Rutherford, New Jersey, we provide a wide array of manufacturing services designed to fit the
diverse needs of multi-sized corporations nationwide. We’re known for our extraordinary ability to
solve manufacturing problems and provide real solutions no matter what the nature and extent of the
project. Our experience and expertise runs deep. Our commitment to quality, integrity, and our
clients’ success is stronger than ever.

Our fundamental mission is to furnish our clients with an end-product of unparalleled quality and
excellence. NutraPak USA welcomes the challenge to step up to the plate and dedicate its
**[state-of-the-art manufacturing][85]** and production resources to fulfill the packaging needs of
your company and its contact packaging projects. We want to earn your business and be
your supplement supplier.

EuroPharma Alliance is a leading manufacturer of dietary supplements in Poland. For more than 10

* Sachets - practical, convenient individual packaging

our products are carefully selected to support health and well-being.

We have a modern machine park that allows us to produce the highest quality products. We use
machines from renowned companies such as Technophar, InvPack or Viking Masks. In combination with
full automation of production, this guarantees us fast execution of orders while maintaining the
highest standards.

recipes, selection of production technology, and then we undertake large-scale production. Thanks to
many years of experience, we are able to offer solutions perfectly tailored to the needs of the
client.

ISO 14001 certificates, which confirm high standards in this regard. In addition, all supplements
pass rigorous quality checks. You can be sure that you will receive the highest quality product.

We combine Polish production with European know-how. We draw on the best practices and expertise of
specialists from all over Europe. This enables us to offer our customers innovative products at
competitive prices.

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this
  option.

# Your brand is our business.

We are your trusted CDMO partner, supporting the development of nutrition products.

Tell us your idea and we make it happen.

[ Start a consultation ][64]

## Quality is part of our DNA

For us, quality is central to our operations. As a CDMO, SIRIO applies structured quality management
processes across the product lifecycle – from raw material sourcing and supply chain oversight
through to market readiness.

Our solutions support a wide range of branded products in the consumer health category. We offer
pre-developed concepts designed to support efficient product development and category alignment.

#### Beauty

Our range of formulations designed for beauty-related product positioning considers ingredient
selection and dosage form design in line with category expectations.

[ Find out more ][75]

#### Sport

These concepts are designed for sports and active lifestyle positioning, with formulations developed
to align with category-specific product requirements.

[ Find out more ][76]

## Our locations

[Discover them here][77]

SIRIO operates manufacturing, production and quality facilities across multiple regions, including
Europe and Asia.

## Our Story

Learn more about SIRIO and our role as a CDMO in the dietary supplement industry. SIRIO provides
contract development and manufacturing services for softgels and related dosage forms.

Our service offering integrates development, manufacturing and quality activities. Research and

##### Your source for custom softgel capsules

# Softgel Source LLC

Specializing in manufacturing quality custom and private label softgel capsules filled with various
active ingredients including vitamins, medications, supplements and pet products. We handle
ingredient selection to ensure compatibility with the softgel format, source and formulate the fill
material to your specifications, test and validate to ensure efficacy, safety, and quality.

##### Expert Custom Softgel Manufacturers

## Committed to U.S. manufacturing of safe, high quality custom softgel products.

Softgel Source LLC is a Portland, Oregon USA based softgel manufacturer that specializes in
manufacturing high quality custom and private label softgel capsules, a popular delivery method for
various products like:
* **Nutritional supplements:** Vitamins, minerals, herbal extracts, and fish oils.
* **Pharmaceuticals:** Over-the-counter and prescription medications.
* **Cosmetics:** Oils and other beauty ingredients.
* **Pet Products:** Medications and supplements for our furry friends.

Our operations include:
* **Fill Material Formulation and Development:** We often assist clients in developing custom
  softgel fill material formulations, ensuring stability, active fill material bioavailability, and
  desired release profiles.
* **Softgel Encapsulation:** This core process involves:
  * Preparing a gelatin solution for the capsule shell.
  * Mixing the fill material (liquid, oil, or paste)
  * Using specialized machinery to simultaneously form the shell, fill it with the desired fill
    material, and seal it.
* **Quality Control:** Rigorous testing is conducted throughout the manufacturing process to ensure
  product quality, consistency, and compliance with industry regulations.
* **Packaging and Labeling:** Finished softgels are packaged and labeled according to client
  specifications, ready for distribution.

Key characteristics of a small business in this sector:
* **Flexibility:** We cater to smaller clients and offer more flexibility in terms of custom
  formulation, batch sizes, and packaging.
* **Low Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ):** We specialize in fast turnaround, low quantity orders.
  Perfect for prototyping and testing.
* **Production Scheduling:** Being 100% Made in the USA makes it easy for us to accommodate special
  client scheduling requirements including, “Rush Orders”
* **Personalized Service:** We provide more personalized attention and support to our clients

Filling our enquiry form is the first step towards getting in touch with us. It helps us understand

## WHY CHOOSE US

###### THE REASONS THAT YOU SHOULD CONTACT US
* **Leading Third-Party Manufacturer**– We are a leading third-party manufacturer producing
  high-quality pharmaceutical products, including General Health Tablets, Vitamin B Complex Syrup,
  Eye Drops, Liver Tonics, Multivitamins, Syrups & Capsules, Injections, herbals, nutraceuticals,

  products ready quickly. Our **3rd Party Manufacturing** Pharmaceuticals units have high-speed
  mixing machines, capsule and powder filling machines, loading, and capping units, air compressors
  and filtration machines, and other equipment.
* **PCD Pharma Ready Products**– Torso Healthcare also has ready products, and we give PCD Pharma
  franchise to business that needs prepared products. We have a ready stock of essential
  pharmaceuticals and fulfil all the orders on the go so companies can save time and serve their
  customers quickly.
* **Reasonable Prices**– Most of our products are available at affordable prices so that our clients
  can have a large margin on the products. All our products have the best artwork & designs
  regarding packaging and other aspects of medicine.
* **Client-Centric Approach**– We are a client-centric company dealing with putting customer
  satisfaction as our top priority. All our products go through strict quality checks so our clients
  can easily sell them at a larger profit margin.
* **Large Distribution Network**– We have a very large delivery network allowing us to deliver the
  product nationwide. Once you become our client, we will be able to timely deliver your order
  without any delay and with full safety.
